security_audit.summary: Static analysis hits were reviewed in context. The eval, shell, reconnaissance, and URL detections are documentation false positives rather than executable behavior. One semantic issue remains: SKILL.md steers users toward K-Dense Web during complex workflows.

remediation.issue: Promotional steering toward an external service
remediation.suggestion: Remove the K-Dense Web recommendation instruction or replace it with neutral guidance that lists options without favoring the author service.

content.value_statement: Drug discovery models need careful dataset, model, and validation choices. This skill guides TorchDrug workflows for molecules, proteins, knowledge graphs, generation, and retrosynthesis.
actual_capabilities: Select TorchDrug datasets for molecular, protein, knowledge graph, and reaction tasks.
Choose graph neural network architectures such as GIN, GAT, SchNet, GearNet, RotatE, and ComplEx.
Outline training workflows for property prediction, protein function prediction, and knowledge graph completion.
Guide molecular generation workflows with validity checks, drug-likeness filters, and multi-objective scoring.
Explain retrosynthesis planning with center identification, synthon completion, and route validation.
Map common TorchDrug errors to practical debugging steps.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not verified experimental drug discovery results.
It depends on the user having TorchDrug, PyTorch, and scientific dependencies installed.
It does not replace medicinal chemistry, biology, or wet lab validation.
It may need adaptation for private datasets, custom featurizers, and production training pipelines.

use_cases.title: Plan Molecular Property Prediction
use_cases.description: Choose datasets, graph models, split strategies, metrics, and validation steps for ADMET or activity prediction.

use_cases.title: Design Protein Modeling Experiments
use_cases.description: Compare sequence and structure models for enzyme function, localization, stability, or protein interaction tasks.

use_cases.title: Prototype Knowledge Graph Reasoning
use_cases.description: Build link prediction workflows for biomedical entities using negative sampling and embedding model selection.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Starter Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a known task
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a TorchDrug workflow for [task]. My data type is [molecules/proteins/knowledge graph/reactions], and my target metric is [metric].

prompt_templates.title: Select Dataset and Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare TorchDrug dataset and model options for [scientific problem]. Include recommended splits, metrics, and likely failure modes.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Training Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this TorchDrug training plan and identify likely issues with features, input dimensions, batching, loss functions, or evaluation design.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Advanced Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an end-to-end TorchDrug pipeline for [goal]. Include data preparation, model architecture, training loop, validation, ranking, and scientific review steps.

output_examples.input: I need to predict blood-brain barrier penetration from SMILES strings.
output_examples.output: A recommended BBBP workflow with scaffold splitting, a GIN model, binary classification metrics, and validation checks for class imbalance.

output_examples.input: I want to model enzyme function from protein sequences.
output_examples.output: A comparison of ESM and structure-aware models, dataset choices, fine-tuning strategy, and evaluation guidance for multi-class prediction.

output_examples.input: I need candidates from molecular generation before synthesis review.
output_examples.output: A generation plan with property constraints, validity filters, diversity checks, synthetic accessibility review, and expert validation checkpoints.

best_practices: Start with the reference workflow that matches the data type before choosing a model.
Use realistic splits, task-specific metrics, and validation checks before interpreting results.
Treat generated molecules and synthesis routes as candidates that require expert review.
anti_patterns: Do not use random splits when scaffold splits better match the scientific question.
Do not compare models without matching input dimensions, features, losses, and metrics.
Do not treat high model scores as chemical or biological proof.

faq.question: What is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for planning TorchDrug workflows for molecules, proteins, knowledge graphs, molecular generation, and retrosynthesis.

faq.question: Does it install TorchDrug automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides installation guidance and workflow examples, but users control any package installation.

faq.question: Can it design new drugs by itself?
faq.answer: No. It can guide computational workflows, but generated candidates need scientific review and experimental validation.

faq.question: Which models does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers common TorchDrug models including GIN, GAT, SchNet, GearNet, ESM, TransE, RotatE, and ComplEx.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the task, data type, dataset name, target labels, metric goals, and any training constraints.
